summary.headline: Affle 3i Q1 FY27 revenue rose 20.4% y-o-y to INR 7.47 billion with EBITDA of INR 1.68 billion (22.4% margin), though management flagged RMG and FinTech headwinds.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue grew 20.4% y-o-y and 3.1% q-o-q to INR 7.47 billion, the 14th consecutive quarter of sequential top-line growth. EBITDA rose 20% y-o-y to INR 1.68 billion with margin at 22.4%, and PAT grew 21.7% y-o-y to INR 1.28 billion. Management said over 95% of revenue grew above 25% y-o-y after adjusting for regulatory and macro headwinds in RMG and some FinTech categories. Operating cash flow to PAT was weak in the quarter, which management attributed to timing of collections after a strong March 2026. The company reiterated a 10x growth plan with a larger acquisition targeted to close by early 2027.

financial_highlights.change: +20% y-o-y; +4% q-o-q; margin up from 22.3% in Q4
Up INR 2.3 million q-o-q on business promotion in Developed Markets

financial_highlights.value: About 41% (per analyst question; not disputed by management)
financial_highlights.change: Management expects about 80-85% OCF to PAT by Q3

segments.name: India and Emerging Markets
segments.commentary: Grew 20.2% y-o-y and 4% q-o-q, contributing 72.2% of Q1 FY27 revenue. Management called it the anchor of growth and sees no challenge to sustained growth.

segments.name: Developed Markets
segments.commentary: Grew 20.7% y-o-y and about 1% q-o-q, contributing 27.8% of revenue. Management targets at least 20% growth here and says the ex-currency growth an analyst estimated at 11-12% is not the right read.

guidance_outlook: Management models about 20% organic growth on a medium-term basis, with internal planning at 25%.
Combined entity including the larger M&A is expected to keep growing at least 20%, with accretive EPS and cash flow.
Larger M&A: third-party due diligence under way; closing targeted by early 2027.
AdColony assets: aim to activate over 100,000 mobile apps to reach over 500 million connected devices in Developed Markets within this year, via existing teams and SDK integrations.
Management expects better margin expansion within FY27, especially in Developed Markets.
OCF to PAT expected to normalise in Q2, reaching about 80-85% by Q3 FY27.
10x growth target to be achieved in about five years; next milestone of USD 1 billion revenue cited as a few years away.
capex_capacity: No capex or capacity figures were discussed. The business is asset-light, CPCU-based.
AdColony asset acquisition is described as complete; management said it requires no significant new capital.
Management said the company has raised the appropriate funding for the larger M&A, with no amount disclosed.
Bobble investment of INR 136 crore: no impairment taken; management said it will be tested once the NCLT appeal is decided.
demand_pricing: RMG (gaming/category G) remains in a recovery phase after regulatory and macro headwinds; FinTech also saw some impact.
Category E and F are robust; category H (healthcare, hospitality) is seeing momentum. In Developed Markets, categories E and G are currently stronger than F and H.
Average CPCU rate is above INR 60; currency-adjusted pricing passed some benefit to advertisers, weighing on margin in the short term.
Management said no material USD volatility in Q1, unlike Q4, when a steep USD move raised inventory cost. Q1 was flat sequentially on this front.

Direct customers contributed about 79% of revenue in Q1 versus about 74% in FY26; management said it does not prefer direct or agency billing and that 100% of business has direct advertiser integration.

qa_highlights.question: Which markets saw the negative impact, and can growth exceed 25% annualised in a normal environment?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said RMG (no longer a contributor this year) and some FinTech and categories were hit. Adjusted, 95% of revenue grew over 25%; management did not commit to timing for 100% of business.

qa_highlights.question: Gross margin trend and recovery timing?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed the pressure to currency-adjusted CPCU pass-through and Developed Markets investment, and pointed to AdColony and margin expansion within FY27. No specific margin figure was given.

qa_highlights.question: Why was OCF to EBITDA weak (about 41%)?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO Kapil Bhutani said about INR 40-45 crore of collections were pulled into March 2026 ahead of year-end, leaving fewer receivables to collect; normalisation expected in Q2 and Q3, with about 80-85% OCF to PAT by Q3.

qa_highlights.question: Currency impact on growth and costs?
qa_highlights.answer: About 72% of business is India and Emerging Markets with cross-currency ROI commitments; only about 20% of US business is USD-to-USD. Q1 USD movement was flat sequentially versus a sharp Q4 spike.

qa_highlights.question: Developed Markets CPCU unit economics?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Developed Markets are easier on unit economics than Emerging Markets, with traffic volume about 5x lower for a given revenue. No exact CPCU or margin figures were given.

qa_highlights.question: Bobble write-down risk (INR 136 crore investment)?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Bobble is a valuable asset with 15-18 million active users, is contesting insolvency with appeals and inspection-rights orders, and will decide on next steps in coming quarters. CFO said no reliable basis for permanent impairment yet; test to follow NCLT appeal ruling.

risks_watch: Regulatory and macro headwinds in RMG and FinTech may persist; management gave no timeline for full recovery.
Gross margin pressure from currency-adjusted CPCU pass-through and Developed Markets investment; no quantified target.
Working-capital and OCF conversion: Q1 OCF to EBITDA was weak; watch for normalisation to 80-85% OCF to PAT by Q3.
Larger M&A (early 2027 close): size, valuation, margin profile and funding not disclosed; management said it will be accretive.
Bobble: INR 136 crore investment is under insolvency; impairment decision deferred pending NCLT appeal.
AdColony rollout: achieving 100,000 app activations and 500 million devices in Developed Markets this year is unquantified in revenue terms.
summary.management_tone: Confident and expansive on long-term 10x growth, Developed Markets and AI, but cautious and vague on specifics. Management avoided quantifying margin targets, M&A size or CPCU economics, and was defensive on the Bobble write-down question, citing legal proceedings.
key_quotes: Q1 FY2027 marks our 14th consecutive quarter of sequential top-line growth and we recorded our highest ever quarterly revenue, EBITDA, PAT and consumer conversions.

We aim to close the larger M&A by early 2027 and the identified targets shall accelerate our expansion across Developed Markets by providing deeper and differentiated access to customers and verticals.

I would only sign on the dotted line and invest if I am convinced that under Affle leadership, the existing business as well as the new inorganic acquisition would continue to deliver combined at least 20% growth and will deliver a meaningful bottom-line performance, growing our Earnings Per Share, growing our cash flows meaningfully.
Kapil Bhutani: From the accounting perspective, it was discussed and since it is in early stage, there is no reliable basis to make a permanent impairment on the asset.
